india.one_line: India sees defence AI tie‑up, AI infrastructure funding, and Freshworks acquisition.

themes.title: Sarvam AI partners with Indian defence
themes.text: Sarvam AI signed a five‑year memorandum of understanding with the Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff of India’s Ministry of Defence to design, develop and deploy AI for operational, training and decision‑support needs across the Army, Navy and Air Force.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI signs five‑year MoU with Indian defence to develop AI applications

themes.title: AM Intelligence seeks $3 billion for Nvidia chips
themes.text: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence is looking to raise up to $3 billion, including bonds, bank loans and a $300 million advance payment, to finance its order of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin systems.

stories.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase

themes.title: Freshworks acquires Israeli AI startup
themes.text: Freshworks bought Israel‑based AI startup Robusta Dev, adding AI‑driven incident investigation and remediation capabilities to its Freshservice IT service‑management platform.

stories.headline: Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to add incident‑investigation AI to Freshservice
Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to boost incident management
